title: Implement Robust Error Handling Middleware
description: This feature matters because it will improve the overall stability and user experience of the yantraverse framework by providing informative error messages and handling unexpected errors. It will add a middleware layer to catch and handle errors, logging the errors for debugging purposes. This will enable developers to quickly identify and fix issues in their applications.
testCases: Test error handling for synchronous errors
Test error handling for asynchronous errors
acceptance: The error handling middleware should catch and log errors, providing a user-friendly error message to the client. The middleware should handle both synchronous and asynchronous errors, and the logs should contain the error message and stack trace.
reason: Implementing robust error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework, as it ensures that the application remains stable and provides valuable debugging information in case of errors.
